# ESP32-S3 upstream refresh A/B at kixel-ai/rind `8a5977ad`, CPU at 240 MHz, second session: every image

rind's time for each image, in µs: the median over that image's flashes, with the number of flashes (n) and the spread (slowest − fastest flash) / fastest. A ratio is the image's median over the control's (`ctl`); below 1 is faster than the control. `ctl` was flashed 6 times; `zero` was flashed once; `rot` was flashed once; `notag` was flashed once; `poly` was flashed once; `all` was flashed once. An image flashed once has one run, so its spread is 0 and says nothing about repeatability; read it against the control's spread. The RustCrypto column is the median of every flash of every image (the same RustCrypto code in each image, a layout control). Every number here is recomputed from [ab.json](ab.json) by `cargo verify`.
